subject: dym-f
title: DYM.F.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-31, the third on book p169. DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) is crossed with MT-INFO (music information). Two upstream feeds: IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism) → DYM-F, and AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) → DYM-F, with AFL-DY also feeding POST (postulation). DYM-F outputs to MT-INFO (the crossing) and to CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus). MT-INFO recursively feeds POST. POST then chains: → BSCF (basic scientific functionalism) → C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism); and POST → PR-TRS (primary transition, a diagram-only compound). Structural argument: dynamic functionalism is co-constituted by isolated-focus-activism and affinity-dynamics, and its outputs (music information, culture information focus) eventually loop back through postulation — which itself is fed by the music-information output. Postulation thus becomes the *recursive* hub, producing both basic-scientific-functionalism→composite-focused-activism and primary-transition. Read against the UPB(II) section: this is Braxton's diagrammatic specification of how dynamic-functionalism (the section's core philosophical claim about creativity's purposive role) is built — not by single-shot derivation, but by a feedback loop in which music-information re-feeds postulation to generate both science-application and primary-transition.
